title: AUTH payload v1.0
description: One synthetic network authentication attempt for an identified subscriber; no credentials are carried.

authenticationId.description: Synthetic business identity for this attempt; a new attempt has a new ID.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the synthetic serving network at attempt time.

deviceId.description: Stable synthetic device identity; never an actual IMEI or customer device identifier.

networkNodeId.description: Synthetic serving node handling the authentication attempt.
